encryption_key.description: The agent's public P-256 encryption key: base64url, with no padding, of the 65-byte uncompressed point.

machine_id.description: The machine ID of the host.

public_key.description: The agent's Ed25519 signing key, in base64.

signature.description: The signature of the request by the signing key, in base64.

token.description: The join token, osapi_jt_<id>.<secret>, from osapi controller join token create. A secret: a reference, secret://<vault>/<key>, or the value.
